# Geometry garden

An original procedural scene the tests read; the site does not serve it. Geometry and materials are
generated by `scripts/docs/garden-source.ts` under the repository license, with no third-party
models, textures, shaders or sample code.

Nine parametric rings and one wave-shaped plinth hold 35,840 source triangles, lit by an imported
directional light that casts shadows. The native compiler generates the manifest and geometry pages
the render proofs load. A compact scene, not a performance benchmark nor a demonstration of
large-scene residency pressure.

Regenerate from the repository root with `pnpm build:native`, then `pnpm docs:scene`;
`TRILLION3D_COMPILER_BIN` optionally selects a compatible compiler executable. Source generation is
deterministic; compiler timings and source provenance reflect the actual compilation run.
